name: Chen's Empty Keg
summary: In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn hopes to bring Chen Stormstout's potent brew back with wild Barrens ingredients.

sections.title: A Legacy in a Keg
sections.body: A marked keg recalls Chen Stormstout to Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet. Chen entrusted the secrets of his namesake brew to Drohn's mentor, who passed them on to Drohn. The recipe calls for raw, potent parts from the Barrens' fierce wildlife. To those outside the brewing trade, that is an unusual choice.

sections.title: Harvesting the Savannah
sections.body:
To revive Chen's potent draught, you gather plainstrider kidneys, savannah lion tusks, and a thunder lizard horn. The ingredients must come from resilient beasts, so your hunt crosses the dusty plains.

When you bring them to Drohn, he fondly recalls earlier batches of trogg brew. Reviving the old formula warms his stomach almost as much as those past brews.

faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn is an orc brewmaster in Ratchet, the port town. His mentor received recipes from the wandering Chen Stormstout and passed the brewing art on to Drohn.

faq.q: Why does a beer recipe require animal kidneys and horns?
faq.answer: Pandaren brewing traditions and frontier adaptations use powerful, esoteric ingredients from local wildlife. They lend vigor, kick, and distinct natural essences to potent draughts.

faq.q: Where can the required ingredients be found?
faq.answer: Plainstriders and savannah lions roam the Barrens' open grasslands. Thunder lizards graze in its drier or rockier stretches.
Chen Stormstout is a wandering pandaren brewmaster who traveled across Kalimdor during the founding of Durotar. He aided the Horde while seeking rare, exotic ingredients to perfect his potent beers.

faq.q: What happens after bringing the ingredients to Drohn?
aliases: next quest after chens empty keg
faq.answer: When you bring Drohn the lion tusks, plainstrider kidneys, and thunder lizard horn, he is delighted. The ingredients recall his earlier brewing days and lead into the final phase of recreating the draught.

faq.q: What is the trogg brew Drohn mentions?
faq.answer: Drohn fondly recalls trogg brew when he sees the wild ingredients. His recollection shows his eccentric history of fermenting harsh, unusual concoctions on the frontier.

angles.text: For a cook, this brings frontier butchery and fine brewing together in the making of legendary Kalimdor spirits.
Chen Stormstout fought alongside Rexxar to help establish Durotar. Remnants of his journey carry special cultural meaning for the Horde.
As an orc, you can see Drohn as an example of orcs embracing ancient brewmaster traditions passed down by travelers who walked with the early Horde.
